<a id="music_instruments"></a>
### [`music_instruments`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L6) `$E80A-$E849`

*data*

8 instruments of 8 bytes: AD/SR pairs for articulation 0, 1, 2 and 2 unused bytes (command $Bn).

- **Referred to by:** [`music_cmd_instrument`](music_player.md#music_cmd_instrument) [`$E731`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L785), [`music_cmd_instrument`](music_player.md#music_cmd_instrument) [`$E740`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L793), [`music_cmd_instrument`](music_player.md#music_cmd_instrument) [`$E74F`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L801), [`music_cmd_filter`](music_player.md#music_cmd_filter) [`$E782`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L829), [`music_cmd_filter`](music_player.md#music_cmd_filter) [`$E789`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L832), [`music_cmd_filter`](music_player.md#music_cmd_filter) [`$E790`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L835), [`music_cmd_filter`](music_player.md#music_cmd_filter) [`$E795`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L838)

<a id="music_filter_presets"></a>
### [`music_filter_presets`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L16) `$E84A-$E869`

*data*

8 filter presets of 4 bytes: cutoff low, cutoff high, resonance (high nibble), filter mode bits (command $Dn). Read as music_instruments+$40.

<a id="music_tune_table"></a>
### [`music_tune_table`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L50) `$E8C0-$E8C7`

*data*

Tune table, 8 bytes per tune: stream pointers of voice 1, 2, 3 and an instrument table pointer that the code does not read. Entry 1 is stale: $EAB3 is a copy of music_title_v1, $EB60 and $EC14 point into the sound effect player and its tables.

- **Referred to by:** [`music_set_voice_ptrs`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_ptrs) [`$E373`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L256), [`music_set_voice_ptrs`](music_player.md#music_set_voice_ptrs) [`$E37B`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L260)

<a id="music_title_v1"></a>
### [`music_title_v1`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L54) `$E8D0-$E97C`

*data*

Title tune, voice 1 stream: the bass (pulse, instrument 3). Its volume command $9C has no effect: the $9F of voices 2 and 3 replaces it before the first note.

- **Read by:** [`music_fetch_v1`](music_player.md#music_fetch_v1) [`$E3DE`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L318) (+16)
- **Entry of:** [`music_tune_table`](../tables.md#music_tune_table)
